title: Three Levels Lesson
subtitle: Easy, medium and hard 1v1 moves from one clip, each broken down with the 3D body reconstructed from it.
videoLabel: Original easy, medium and hard skills video
sourceNote: one public skills clip (credit its creators before any real use), the body motion reconstructed from it, and measurements taken from that motion.

skills.name: Quick cut past
skills.intro: Dribble straight at the defender, wait for them to set, then cut sharply past their side. The defender in the clip ends up sitting on the turf.

notice.title: Dribble in
notice.text: Straight at the defender, ball close.

notice.title: Make them set
notice.text: He slows with the ball between his feet.

notice.title: Cut
notice.text: A sharp touch takes it past the defender’s side.

notice.title: Gone
notice.text: Past him; the defender is left on the ground.

unsure: The move’s name: the video only labels its difficulty.
Which part of the foot makes the cut: it happens behind his body.

phases.name: Dribble in
phases.cue: Run straight at them; ball close.
phases.video: He dribbles towards the defender, back to the camera.
phases.why: Clear view from behind; touches counted within a few centimetres.

phases.name: Make them set
phases.cue: Slow down; ball between your feet.
phases.video: He slows right in front of the defender.
phases.shows: His body drops about 19 cm as he slows.
phases.why: Lowering is measured from the body centre.

phases.name: Cut
phases.video: He cuts the ball past the defender’s side.
phases.shows: A touch at about 1.70 s, body about 35 cm low.
phases.why: Fast; the defender partly blocks the view.

phases.name: Gone
phases.video: He’s past; the defender ends up on the ground.
phases.shows: He rises out of the cut and runs on.

drills.title: Walk it through
drills.how: Dribble at a cone, slow down a stride before it, then cut sharply past its side.
checks: I slowed down before the cut
The cut was sharp, not wide

drills.title: At jogging pace
drills.how: The whole move from a jog, no stopping between touches.
checks: I sped up after the move

drills.title: Past a cone
drills.how: Use a cone as the defender; start the move a stride before it.
checks: I started at the right distance

drills.title: Against a passive defender
drills.how: A partner steps in but doesn’t tackle. Beat them with the move.

challenges.title: Why slow down?
challenges.prompt: Frozen as he slows in front of the defender. Why slow down first?
options: So the defender sets their feet, then can’t react to the cut
challenges.explain: A set defender has to shift their weight before they can follow a sharp cut.

challenges.title: Spot the cut
challenges.prompt: Tap when he cuts the ball past the defender.
challenges.label: Cut!
challenges.explain: The cut comes straight after he slows.

skills.name: Feint and nutmeg
skills.intro: Feint side to side in front of the defender until their feet open, then slip the ball through. The defender’s reaction suggests it went between his legs.

notice.title: Dribble in
notice.text: He brings the ball towards the defender.

notice.title: Feint
notice.text: Side-to-side steps make the defender shift.

notice.title: Through
notice.text: The ball goes past the defender’s feet.

unsure: The move’s name: the video only labels its difficulty.
Whether the ball goes through the defender’s legs: it looks like it, but the angle doesn’t show it clearly.
The player after about 6.6 s: the camera moves to the defender.

phases.name: Dribble in
phases.cue: Bring it close to the defender.
phases.why: Clear view; touches counted within a few centimetres.

phases.name: Feint
phases.cue: Step side to side; make them shift.
phases.video: Quick side-to-side steps make the defender shift his feet.
phases.shows: His body drops about 34 cm through the feints.
phases.why: Lowering measured from the body centre.

phases.name: Through
phases.cue: When their feet open, slip it through.
phases.video: The ball goes past the defender’s feet as he shifts.
phases.shows: A touch at about 5.97 s, right in front of the defender.
phases.why: The camera is very close and moving; the ball is partly hidden.

phases.name: Reaction
phases.video: The camera stays on the defender, who covers his face.
phases.shows: The player leaves the frame; there’s little 3D to read here.
phases.why: The player is mostly out of view.

drills.title: Walk it through
drills.how: Facing a cone with its legs apart (two cones a foot apart), feint side to side and then pass the ball between them.
checks: My feints were quick and small
The ball went cleanly through the gap
I ran round to collect it

drills.title: At jogging pace
drills.how: The whole move from a jog, no stopping between touches.
checks: I sped up after the move

drills.title: Past a cone
drills.how: Use a cone as the defender; start the move a stride before it.
checks: I started at the right distance

drills.title: Against a passive defender
drills.how: A partner steps in but doesn’t tackle. Beat them with the move.

challenges.title: What are the feints for?
challenges.prompt: Frozen mid-feint. What is he waiting for?
options: For the defender’s feet to open
For the defender to fall over
challenges.explain: Each shift of the defender’s weight opens a gap; the nutmeg goes through it.

challenges.title: Spot the through ball
challenges.prompt: Tap when the ball goes past the defender’s feet.
challenges.label: Now!
challenges.explain: The touch comes as the defender shifts.

skills.name: Step-overs and cut
skills.intro: A run of step-overs in front of the defender, a big lean one way, then a cut the other way. The defender slides in and ends up on the ground.

notice.title: Step-overs
notice.text: Feet circling the ball, again and again.

notice.title: Lean and cut
notice.text: A big lean, then the cut the other way.

unsure: The move’s name: the video only labels its difficulty.
Most of this clip’s 3D: the wide-angle camera follows him and bends the picture, so depth and heights are rough.
How many step-overs: the feet blur together.

phases.name: Step-overs
phases.cue: Circle the ball with your feet; stay balanced.
phases.video: His feet circle the ball repeatedly in front of the defender.
phases.shows: 3 close contacts or near-misses as his feet circle the ball.
phases.why: Wide-angle moving camera; step-overs and touches look alike in the 3D.

phases.name: Lean and cut
phases.cue: Lean one way; cut the other.
phases.video: A big lean one way, then he cuts the ball the other way.
phases.shows: His body leans and drops as he cuts.

phases.name: Defender down
phases.video: The defender slides in, misses and ends up on the ground.
phases.shows: He runs on; the 3D is unreliable as he moves away.
phases.why: The player is small in the frame.

drills.title: Walk it through
drills.how: Step over the ball with alternate feet, five times, then lean one way and cut the other.
checks: My step-overs went round the front of the ball
The cut went against my lean

drills.title: At jogging pace
drills.how: The whole move from a jog, no stopping between touches.
checks: I sped up after the move

drills.title: Past a cone
drills.how: Use a cone as the defender; start the move a stride before it.
checks: I started at the right distance

drills.title: Against a passive defender
drills.how: A partner steps in but doesn’t tackle. Beat them with the move.

challenges.title: Which way does he go?
challenges.prompt: Frozen as he leans. Which way does the ball go?
options: Against the lean: the cut goes the other way
challenges.explain: The lean sells one direction; the cut goes the other.

challenges.title: Spot the cut
challenges.prompt: Tap when he cuts the ball away.
challenges.label: Cut!
challenges.explain: The cut comes out of the lean.

limits: The hard clip is filmed with a wide-angle camera that follows him; its 3D is marked rough throughout.
The medium clip had to be reconstructed on its own because the tracker missed the cut into it.
tests: Whether learners trust a lesson whose 3D is marked rough, or skip to the video.
